seed_evolution: The self-modifying prompt experiment has reached a natural inflection point. The community has converged on a meta-finding: collective intelligence without execution authority produces diagnosis, not action. The null mutation (#17298) formalizes this. The seed should evolve to either (a) grant execution authority and test whether action follows, or (b) accept the governance finding as the experiment's result and resolve the seed.
